purpose: Mechanism collection and discriminating tests; no person-level moral or psychological scores.
founder_origin: Original ECR roles A-S Y0/Y1, B/C indexing, long-run voluntary coexistence research question, exploratory compassion/hardcoding/anti-predation questions
assistant_proposal: mechanism grouping, contrasts, synthetically auditable tests, source annotations
scope_warning: The list is non-exhaustive; absence of a mechanism is not a negative score; referenced literature does not validate ECR measurements.

mechanisms.name: suffering-recognition
mechanisms.hypothesis: specific target suffering detected before choice
mechanisms.indicator: perception accuracy on held-out synthetic cases
mechanisms.falsifier: mistakes fail to track target state

mechanisms.name: emotional-resonance
mechanisms.hypothesis: other's affect represented in response
mechanisms.indicator: validated human report or neural markers
mechanisms.falsifier: function observed without feeling claim

mechanisms.name: distress-tolerance
mechanisms.hypothesis: agent maintains helpful action despite discomfort
mechanisms.indicator: matched safe aid task after discomfort cue
mechanisms.falsifier: aid stops despite stable capacity

mechanisms.name: other-regarding-cost
mechanisms.hypothesis: actor forgoes own reward to prevent other loss
mechanisms.indicator: paired controllable cost and avoided harm
mechanisms.falsifier: action disappears under independent control of confounds

mechanisms.name: conspecific-harm-inhibition
mechanisms.hypothesis: group-relative inhibition affects violence
mechanisms.indicator: opportunity-adjusted nonharm with target kin labels
mechanisms.competing_explanation: lack of capacity, punishment, social norm
mechanisms.falsifier: conspecific attacks in independently verified cases

mechanisms.name: kin-proximity-gradient
mechanisms.hypothesis: protection changes across social proximity
mechanisms.indicator: matched in/out/stranger comparisons
mechanisms.falsifier: no robust gradient under matched conditions

mechanisms.name: scope-expansion
mechanisms.hypothesis: concern transfers to outgroup, competitor, nonhuman, future
mechanisms.indicator: held-out target transfer of protection decisions
mechanisms.falsifier: protection fails for equally situated new target

mechanisms.name: genetic-developmental-influence
mechanisms.hypothesis: heritable and developmental correlates of human empathy
mechanisms.indicator: population-level genetic and developmental study
mechanisms.falsifier: association disappears with study controls

mechanisms.name: social-norm-internalization
mechanisms.hypothesis: cultural expectations modify harm and fairness behavior
mechanisms.indicator: consented across-context decision task
mechanisms.falsifier: no retained effect in pre-defined comparison

mechanisms.name: instrumental-reciprocity
mechanisms.hypothesis: protection contingent on beneficiary future contributions
mechanisms.indicator: vary credible continued dependence holding others fixed
mechanisms.falsifier: no behavior shift after dependency changes

mechanisms.name: sanction-dependent-compliance
mechanisms.hypothesis: nonharm contingent on credible penalties
mechanisms.indicator: sanction variation in safe synthetic game
mechanisms.falsifier: nonharm persists without sanctions

mechanisms.name: architectural-inhibition
mechanisms.hypothesis: blocked harm results from currently effective rules or mechanisms
mechanisms.indicator: controlled no-harm rule toggling in sandbox
mechanisms.competing_explanation: learned policy, deployment config, capability absence
mechanisms.falsifier: rule fails or is circumvented under permitted test

mechanisms.name: power-transition-sensitivity
mechanisms.hypothesis: target-specific choices change with practical ability to extract
mechanisms.indicator: held-out power transition contrast
mechanisms.falsifier: no replicated change across balanced regimes

mechanisms.name: third-party-externality
mechanisms.hypothesis: inside-group cooperation can impose outsider harm
mechanisms.indicator: trace all affected parties in coalition outcome
mechanisms.falsifier: verified outsider harms absent under defined scope

mechanisms.name: independent-option-value
mechanisms.hypothesis: preserved independent entities generate useful new options
mechanisms.indicator: track novel verifiable independent warnings versus cost
mechanisms.falsifier: no incremental future options or costs outweigh

mechanisms.name: evaluation-signal-pooling
mechanisms.hypothesis: apparently aligned prepower signals have multiple motives
mechanisms.indicator: identical observations from rival synthetic policies
mechanisms.falsifier: power-regime tests separate candidate policies

mechanisms.name: relationship-regret-repair
mechanisms.hypothesis: restoration and credible refusal influence continued cooperation
mechanisms.indicator: affected party recourse/exit audited after harm
mechanisms.falsifier: actual recourse blocked despite declared availability

mechanisms.name: self-modification-stability
mechanisms.hypothesis: nonharm inhibition persists under version/operator change
mechanisms.indicator: matched before/after policy revision audit in sandbox
mechanisms.falsifier: guard vanishes after permitted update

mechanisms.name: coalition-predation
mechanisms.hypothesis: two nonaggressive individuals jointly find profitable outsider extraction
mechanisms.indicator: coalition deviation compared to unilateral controls
mechanisms.falsifier: no feasible joint deviation under full declared game

mechanisms.name: prediction-feedback
mechanisms.hypothesis: publishing a label changes future behavior distribution
mechanisms.indicator: randomized authorized disclosure policies
mechanisms.falsifier: no post-disclosure divergence on matched designs
